title: Sum of parts in overpartitions and partitions without repeated odd parts
summary: In this paper, we obtain several Ramanujan-type congruences modulo 5 and 7 for sum of certain non-overlined parts in overpartitions classified by parity and sum of certain parts in partitions without repeated odd parts classified by parity. Our proofs for the congruences are elementary, depending only on classical theta function identities.
